output_dir.description: Directory where nmon CSV files will be saved. Ignored if capture_mode is false.

output_prefix.description: Prefix for the output filename. The full filename will be generated by nmon based on hostname and date.

capture_mode.description: If true, runs nmon in spreadsheet output mode (-f). If false, runs in interactive curses mode.

refresh_interval.description: Seconds between screen refreshes or data points (-s). Default is 2.

max_count.description: Number of refreshes to perform (-c). 0 means unlimited/until terminated.

include_top_procs.description: If true, includes top processes data in the CSV output (-t).

capacity_planning.description: If true, enables capacity planning mode (-x) which sets specific defaults for long-term monitoring (15 min intervals).

max_disks.description: Maximum number of disks to monitor (-d). Default is 256.
